name: Sales Funnel - Phase 1+2+3+4+5 - Capture through Close & Retain

parameters.content:
## Phase 1 - Capture & Clean

Before running:
1. Set credential 'reacherApi' -> your self-hosted Reacher URL (email verification)
2. Set credential 'postgresLeadsDb' -> your leads staging Postgres DB
3. Set credential 'scraperService' -> your own Playwright/Crawlee microservice URL (n8n Code nodes cannot run headless browsers directly - this must be a small external service you host and call over HTTP)
4. Point the webhook at your lead-capture form / landing page

Output of this workflow: a lead marked status = 'Verified', ready for Phase 2 (Enrich & Score) to pick up.

nodes.name: Webhook - New Lead Form
nodes.notes: Point your website form / landing page submit action at this webhook URL.

nodes.name: Cron - Daily Scrape
nodes.notes: Runs once a day to pull fresh leads from your scraper service.

nodes.name: Call Scraper Service
nodes.notes: Calls YOUR self-hosted scraper microservice (Playwright/Crawlee). n8n's Code node runs in a restricted sandbox and cannot launch a headless browser itself - this HTTP call is the bridge to a small external service you host separately.

nodes.name: Combine Lead Sources
nodes.notes: Combines the webhook path and the scraper path into a single lead stream.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate (Postgres)

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM leads WHERE domain = $1 OR email = $2 LIMIT 1;

nodes.notes: Requires credential 'postgresLeadsDb' pointing at your leads staging table.

nodes.name: Discard Duplicate
nodes.notes: Duplicate leads end here. Nothing further happens.

nodes.name: Verify Email (Reacher)
nodes.notes: Requires credential/env var REACHER_URL pointing at your self-hosted Reacher instance.

nodes.name: Mark Invalid & Log
nodes.notes: Invalid/disposable emails are logged here and do not proceed further.

nodes.name: Phase 1 Output - Ready for Enrichment
nodes.notes: This is the handoff point. Phase 2 (Enrich & Score) picks up leads from here.

parameters.content:
## Phase 2 - Enrich & Score

Before running:
1. Set env var APOLLO_API_KEY (or credential 'apolloApi')
2. Set env var SCORING_ENGINE_URL if using self-hosted Ollama for AI scoring - otherwise the Code node below uses a rule-based fallback
3. Picks up any lead reaching 'Phase 1 Output - Ready for Enrichment'

Output: each lead tagged Hot / Warm / Cold / Disqualified, ready for Phase 3 (CRM sync).

nodes.name: Enrich Company (Apollo)
nodes.notes: Requires env var/credential APOLLO_API_KEY.

nodes.name: Loop Decision-Maker Roles
nodes.notes: Iterates over target roles: Owner/Founder, CEO, Marketing Head, Sales Head, Ops/Tech Head.

nodes.name: Collect All Decision Makers
nodes.notes: Aggregates up to 5 decision-maker contact records into one array field.

nodes.name: Phase 2 Output - Hot
nodes.notes: Hand off to Phase 3 CRM sync, priority routing.

nodes.name: Phase 2 Output - Warm
nodes.notes: Hand off to Phase 3 CRM sync.

nodes.name: Phase 2 Output - Cold
nodes.notes: Hand off to Phase 3 CRM sync, nurture track.

nodes.name: Phase 2 Output - Disqualified
nodes.notes: Logged but not actively worked.

parameters.content:
## Phase 3 - CRM Sync

Before running:
1. Set credential 'odooApi' (JSON-RPC user + API key)
2. Set env var ODOO_URL
3. Set env var MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_URL (or swap for Slack/email) for Hot lead alerts

Takes all 4 score-tier outputs from Phase 2, tags each with priority, writes one crm.lead record per lead into Odoo, and alerts on Hot leads only.

Output: lead exists in Odoo with correct stage/priority - ready for Phase 4 (Engage & Convert).

nodes.name: Merge All Tiers
nodes.notes: Recombines all 4 priority branches into a single stream before writing to Odoo.

nodes.name: Create/Update Odoo Lead
nodes.notes: Requires env vars ODOO_URL, ODOO_DB, ODOO_UID, ODOO_API_KEY. Maps enriched fields into crm.lead, including two custom Odoo Studio fields (x_studio_score_tier, x_studio_decision_makers) - create these fields in Odoo Studio before running.

nodes.name: Alert Team (Hot Lead)

parameters.name: text
parameters.value: =Hot lead: {{$json.company}} ({{$json.email}}) just entered the pipeline - score {{$json.lead_score}}

nodes.notes: Swap MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_URL for a Slack incoming webhook or an email node if you'd rather not run Mattermost.

nodes.name: Phase 3 Output - Lead in Odoo CRM
nodes.notes: Handoff point. Phase 4 (Engage & Convert) picks up from here for every lead, regardless of tier.

parameters.content:
## Phase 4 - Engage & Convert

Before running:
1. Set SMTP credential 'outreachSmtp' (or Gmail OAuth) for sending
2. Optional: set AI_DRAFT_URL to a self-hosted Ollama endpoint for personalized copy - falls back to a plain template if unset
3. Set env var CALCOM_API_KEY and CALCOM_BOOKING_URL
4. Set env var GOTENBERG_URL for proposal PDF generation
5. Register a second n8n Webhook (see 'Cal.com Booking Webhook' node) as the redirect/webhook target in your Cal.com event type settings

Follow-up cadence: Day 0 intro, Day 3 value resource, Day 7 case study, Day 14 final follow-up. Each step waits for either a reply or its interval to elapse, whichever comes first, before moving on.

nodes.name: Follow-up Sequence Loop
nodes.notes: Loops one follow-up step at a time. 'Done' output (all 4 steps sent, no reply) fires 'Sequence Complete - No Response'.

nodes.name: Draft Email (AI or Template)

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: =Write a short, personalized {{$json.type}} outreach email to {{$json.contact_name}} at {{$json.company}} ({{$json.industry}}). Keep it under 120 words, no subject line.

nodes.notes: Calls your self-hosted Ollama instance if AI_DRAFT_URL is set. continueOnFail is on so the workflow still proceeds to the template fallback below if Ollama is unreachable or unset.

nodes.name: Send Follow-up Email
nodes.notes: Requires SMTP credential 'outreachSmtp' attached to this node (self-hosted Postal works fine here, or Gmail).

nodes.name: Wait For Reply Or Interval
nodes.notes: Pauses this exact execution. Resumes early if the 'reply webhook' (see mail-parsing setup) is called for this lead, or automatically after wait_hours if not.

nodes.name: Replied?
nodes.notes: If the resume webhook delivered reply_text, this is true. If it resumed from timeout instead, $json.body is empty and this is false.

parameters.subject: =Let's find time to talk
parameters.text: =Great to hear from you - here's my booking link: {{$env.CALCOM_BOOKING_URL}}

nodes.name: Draft Objection Response
nodes.notes: Flags for a human to send a tailored objection response rather than fully automating this reply type.

nodes.name: Cal.com Booking Webhook
nodes.notes: Set this URL as the webhook target in your Cal.com event type. Fires whenever any lead books a meeting.

nodes.name: Mark Meeting Scheduled (Odoo)
nodes.notes: Placeholder for the actual Odoo update call - reuse the 'Create/Update Odoo Lead' node's pattern with method 'write' and this lead's Odoo id from the previous node.

nodes.name: Generate Proposal PDF (Gotenberg)
nodes.notes: Feed this an HTML proposal template with lead fields merged in (company name, scope, pricing) as the multipart 'files' field named index.html. Gotenberg returns the rendered PDF.

nodes.name: Send Proposal Email
nodes.notes: Attach the PDF binary from the previous node in the Attachments field.

nodes.name: Sequence Complete - No Response
nodes.notes: Fires when all 4 follow-up steps have been sent with no reply.

parameters.content:
## Phase 5 - Close & Retain

Picks up from 3 exit points of Phase 4:
- Send Proposal Email (possible Won)
- Mark Not Interested / Unsubscribed (auto Lost)
- Sequence Complete - No Response (auto Lost)

Requires: ODOO_* env vars (reused from Phase 3), Postgres credential `postgresLeadsDb` (reused from Phase 1), SMTP credential on the Welcome Email node, MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_URL (reused from Phase 3).

nodes.name: Wait For Deal Outcome
nodes.notes: Pauses here after the proposal goes out. Call this node's resume webhook with {"outcome": "Won"} or {"outcome": "Lost", "lost_reason": "Price"} when the rep updates the deal in Odoo (wire an Odoo automation/webhook to call this), or from a simple internal form. Auto-resumes after 30 days with no outcome set, which the IF below treats as not-yet-won.

nodes.name: Tag Lost Reason - Manual
nodes.notes: Expects the rep to send a lost_reason of Price / Competitor / No Budget / Timing when they call the resume webhook with outcome: Lost. Falls back to 'Unspecified' if omitted.

nodes.name: Normalize Lost Reason
nodes.notes: Maps free-text or auto-tagged reasons onto the 5 standard buckets from the plan: Price / Competitor / No Budget / Timing / No Response.

nodes.name: Log Lost Deal (Postgres)
nodes.notes: Insert into a `lost_deals` table (company, email, lost_reason, lead_score, lost_at) using the postgresLeadsDb credential from Phase 1. Create this table before running (see README).

nodes.name: Update Odoo Lead - Mark Lost
nodes.notes: Marks the crm.lead inactive/lost in Odoo. Requires odoo_lead_id to be present on the item - carry it through from 'Create/Update Odoo Lead' in Phase 3 (add it to the Set nodes upstream if it isn't already flowing through).

nodes.name: Convert Lead to Customer (Odoo)
nodes.notes: Marks the Odoo lead Won (moves it to the Won stage). Requires odoo_lead_id carried through from Phase 3. If your Odoo version doesn't expose action_set_won_rainbowman via XML-RPC, use write with the Won stage_id instead.

nodes.name: Build Onboarding Checklist
nodes.notes: Fixed 5-item starter checklist per the plan's 'onboarding checklist' requirement. Edit this list to match your actual onboarding process - each item becomes one row in onboarding_tasks.

nodes.name: Insert Onboarding Tasks (Postgres)
nodes.notes: One row per checklist item, using the postgresLeadsDb credential. Create the onboarding_tasks table before running (see README).

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email

parameters.subject: =Welcome aboard, {{$json.company}}!
parameters.text: =Welcome to the team! Your onboarding checklist is underway - you'll hear from us shortly to schedule your kickoff call.

nodes.notes: Attach the same SMTP credential used for the Phase 4 outreach emails.

nodes.name: Schedule Renewal Reminder
nodes.notes: Defaults to a 12-month contract via CONTRACT_LENGTH_MONTHS env var. This just computes and stores the date - Phase 6's nightly sweep (or a separate scheduled check) is what should actually fire the reminder as the date approaches.

nodes.name: Insert Renewal Reminder (Postgres)
nodes.notes: Create the renewal_reminders table before running (see README). A separate small scheduled workflow (or an addition to Phase 6's nightly sweep) should query rows where renewal_date is within N days and send the actual upsell/renewal reminder - that query isn't built here since it depends on your lead time preference.

parameters.name: text
parameters.value: =Deal won: {{$json.company}} is now a customer - onboarding checklist created

main.node: Phase 3 Output - Lead in Odoo CRM
